answer: Assign each answer to graders who sit far from its author in the attestation graph. A sybil ring is an island: its accounts mostly vouch for each other and rarely touch outsiders. If a reviewer must come from a distant part of the network, the ring cannot grade itself upward, and its weak work faces strangers with nothing to gain. Think of a grove where yarrow spreads by runners: cut the roots that loop back to the same patch and you see how few plants there really are.
